A [[Rookie (disambiguation)|rookie]] [[clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was a member of [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and fought in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

==Biography==
In 22 BBY, during the Battle of Ryloth, gunships were carrying the members of Ghost Company toward [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]] village, so they could liberate it from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Acclamator-class assault ships]] which brought the gunships to the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] pulled back from the battle after they had been targeted by [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon]]s, destroying these becoming the mission of the company.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

After the gunships landed, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and the members of Ghost Company began fighting against the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] guarding the outer perimeter of the village. They destroyed the droids and General Kenobi told Commander Cody to send his best men to scout ahead. The commander took [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]], [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] and [[Wooley/Legends|Wooley]]  with him and they went to scout ahead and, after a while, separated into two groups. Cody and Wooley found the [[Separatist command center/Legends|Separatist command center]], the proton canons and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] prisoners the droids were using as leaving shields to protect the guns against Republic attacks. They returned to report this to General Kenobi and, while the latter discussed their strategy with Commander Cody and General [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] was spying on them. Meanwhile, Waxer and Boil encountered [[Numa/Legends|Numa]] and discussed whether to take her with them or leave her where they found her, before following her to make sure she was safe and looking after her.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

Shortly afterwards, [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]], the leader of the Separatist forces in the area, ordered starved [[Gutkurr/Legends|Gutkurrs]] to be released against the Republic forces. They attacked General Kenobi, Commander Cody and the members of Ghost Company and the Jedi Master used a mind trick on the Gutkurrs to lead them away from the clones. As he did so, this clone trooper said that that was incredible and Commander Cody told him to be quiet. General Kenobi led the Gutkurrs to an alley with one-way access and told the clones to shoot a bridge above it. They did so, trapping the Gutkurrs there. Afterwards, Waxer and Boil joined them, along with Numa.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

Numa led General Kenobi, Waxer and Boil to the Twi'lek prisoners, while the rest of Ghost Company, including this rookie clone trooper, attacked the droids guarding them to create a diversion so the prisoners could be rescued by the Jedi and the two clones. Commander Cody, the rookie clone trooper and the rest of the company fought against the droids and, at some point during the battle, the commander told them to retreat to prevent casualties since they were outnumbered and attacked by [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

General Kenobi, Waxer and Boil destroyed the proton cannons and freed the prisoners who destroyed TX-20 as the Acclamators arrived. The Republic won this battle and, afterwards, the entire Battle of Ryloth after General Windu and his forces, along with [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] and the Twi'lek Resistance defeated the Separatist forces in [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]], the capital of the planet, and General Windu captured the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist leader]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /><ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
This clone trooper was impressed by General Kenobi's skill in the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]. He was also very skilled, surviving the battle in the Nabat village.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

==Equipment==
The clone trooper wore [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] and used a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S blaster carbine]] in combat.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

==Behind the scenes==
This clone trooper first appeared in "[[Innocents of Ryloth]]," an episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[March 6]], [[2009]]. Like all clone troopers in the series, he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Innocents of Ryloth">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode020.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref>
